WEEK 1Learn movement patterns, establish knee tolerance and build easy aerobic time.
＋
5 training daysWed + Sun restWomen’s Doubles
MondayRun development + knee
⌄
1Warm Up
Warm up: 5–8 min brisk walk + gentle leg swings
FORM
Move through a comfortable range with control. The goal is to warm the joints and muscles, not force a deep stretch.
2Running / Cardio
6× (3 min easy run + 2 min walk)
Running effort: conversational/easy unless stated otherwise
Cool down: 5 min walk
3Session Notes
Spanish squat or supported wall sit
FORM
Keep your torso upright and knees tracking over your toes. Sit only as low as is comfortable for your knee; hold steady without bouncing.
3×30–45 s, comfortable range
4HYROX Skill / Conditioning
Step-down from low step
2×8/side, slow control (skip if provocative)
▶ Form guide
Place your whole foot on the box and drive through the working leg. Avoid pushing hard off the trailing foot.
5Strength Block
Calf raise
FORM
Stand tall, rise slowly onto the balls of your feet, pause at the top, then lower under control. Keep ankles straight rather than rolling outward.
2×12–15Weight: bodyweight
Slow 2-second lowering; add load only when pain-free and easy.
Side-lying hip abduction
FORM
Lie on your side with the top leg straight. Lift it slightly back and up without rolling your hips open; lower slowly.
2×12/side
Training rule: form first. Use the prescribed load only while you can keep 2–3 clean reps in reserve.
TuesdayStrength + HYROX skill
⌄
1Warm Up
5–8 min easy bike/elliptical + dynamic warm-up
2Strength Block
Leg press
use the week’s prescribed sets/repsWeight: 20 kg shown on the machine
▶ Form guide
First set is a calibration set: if form changes or you have <2 reps in reserve, drop one pin/plate.
Seated hamstring curl
FORM
Set the machine pivot in line with your knee. Curl the pad smoothly toward you without lifting your hips, then return slowly.
prescribed sets/repsWeight: 10 kg shown on the machine
Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
prescribed sets/repsWeight: 2×5 kg
▶ Form guide
Keep the dumbbells close to your legs; stop the descent when your back position would change.
Chest press machine
2–3×8–12Weight: 10 kg shown on the machine
▶ Form guide
Set handles around mid-chest. Keep shoulder blades supported, press smoothly and stop just short of locking elbows hard.
Lat pulldown
2–3×8–12Weight: 15 kg shown on the machine
▶ Form guide
Grip just wider than shoulders, keep chest tall, pull bar toward upper chest and avoid swinging your body backward.
Standing calf raise
FORM
Stand tall, rise slowly onto the balls of your feet, pause at the top, then lower under control. Keep ankles straight rather than rolling outward.
2–3×10–15Weight: bodyweight
Side-lying hip abduction or band lateral walk
FORM
Lie on your side with the top leg straight. Lift it slightly back and up without rolling your hips open; lower slowly.
2×12–15/side
3Session Notes
Strength target this week: 2 sets each • 10–12 reps • RPE 5–6
4HYROX Skill / Conditioning
Technique only: wall ball 3×8
Weight: 2 kg
▶ Form guide
Race load is 4 kg. Use 2 kg only while learning or if knee symptoms rise.
5Session Notes
Rest 60–120 s between normal strength sets; longer if technique needs it
Training rule: form first. Use the prescribed load only while you can keep 2–3 clean reps in reserve.
ThursdayAerobic + upper/body support
⌄
1Session Notes
WARM-UP Warm up 5 min
2Running / Cardio
25–30 min easy bike/elliptical OR repeat a shorter run/walk if knee is green
FORM
Use a comfortable resistance and smooth cadence. This is aerobic work, so you should be able to speak in short sentences.
3Strength Block
Chest press machine
2–3×8–12Weight: 10 kg shown on the machine
▶ Form guide
Set handles around mid-chest. Keep shoulder blades supported, press smoothly and stop just short of locking elbows hard.
Seated cable row
2–3×8–12Weight: 15 kg shown on the machine
▶ Form guide
Sit tall, keep shoulders down, pull elbows back toward your ribs, then return slowly without rounding forward.
Lat pulldown
2×8–12Weight: 15 kg shown on the machine
▶ Form guide
Grip just wider than shoulders, keep chest tall, pull bar toward upper chest and avoid swinging your body backward.
Dumbbell shoulder press
FORM
Sit tall with ribs down. Start dumbbells around shoulder height, press overhead without arching your lower back, then lower with control.
2×8–10Weight: 2×3 kg
Pallof press
FORM
Stand side-on to the cable, brace your core and press the handle straight away from your chest. Do not let your torso rotate.
2×10/sideWeight: 5 kg shown on the cable stack
4Session Notes
Keep this day easier than Friday/Saturday
Training rule: form first. Use the prescribed load only while you can keep 2–3 clean reps in reserve.
⚡ FridayHYROX conditioning
⌄
1HYROX Skill / Conditioning
3 rounds: Ski 250 m + 8 incline push-ups + 10 KB deadlifts + Row 250 m
Weight: 12 kg
▶ Form guide
Start tall with arms high, hinge slightly and drive handles down using lats/core. Return smoothly rather than yanking with the arms.
2Session Notes
WARM-UP Warm up each machine for 3–5 easy min before hard work if unfamiliar
Transitions should be controlled; technique takes priority over clock time
3Cool Down
COOL-DOWN Cool down 5–10 min easy
Training rule: form first. Use the prescribed load only while you can keep 2–3 clean reps in reserve.
SaturdayEndurance / simulation
⌄
1Running / Cardio
35 min easy run/walk: 4:1
2Session Notes
Keep early-phase endurance conversational
Fuel and hydrate normally; do not turn easy sessions into races
Stop/modify if knee moves into amber/red guidance
Training rule: form first. Use the prescribed load only while you can keep 2–3 clean reps in reserve.
WEEK 2Repeat before adding much load. Smooth technique > fatigue.

1Warm Up
Warm up: 5–8 min brisk walk + gentle leg swings
FORM
Move through a comfortable range with control. The goal is to warm the joints and muscles, not force a deep stretch.
2Running / Cardio
3×1 km easy-moderate, 2 min walk between
Running effort: conversational/easy unless stated otherwise
Cool down: 5 min walk
3Session Notes
Spanish squat or supported wall sit
FORM
Keep your torso upright and knees tracking over your toes. Sit only as low as is comfortable for your knee; hold steady without bouncing.
3×30–45 s, comfortable range
4HYROX Skill / Conditioning
Step-down from low step
2×8/side, slow control (skip if provocative)
▶ Form guide
Place your whole foot on the box and drive through the working leg. Avoid pushing hard off the trailing foot.
5Strength Block
Calf raise
FORM
Stand tall, rise slowly onto the balls of your feet, pause at the top, then lower under control. Keep ankles straight rather than rolling outward.
2×12–15Weight: bodyweight
Slow 2-second lowering; add load only when pain-free and easy.
Side-lying hip abduction
FORM
Lie on your side with the top leg straight. Lift it slightly back and up without rolling your hips open; lower slowly.
2×12/side
Training rule: form first. Use the prescribed load only while you can keep 2–3 clean reps in reserve.
TuesdayStrength + HYROX skill
⌄
1Warm Up
5–8 min easy bike/elliptical + dynamic warm-up
2Strength Block
Leg press
use the week’s prescribed sets/repsWeight: 30 kg shown on the machine
▶ Form guide
First set is a calibration set: if form changes or you have <2 reps in reserve, drop one pin/plate.
Seated hamstring curl
FORM
Set the machine pivot in line with your knee. Curl the pad smoothly toward you without lifting your hips, then return slowly.
prescribed sets/repsWeight: 15 kg shown on the machine
Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
prescribed sets/repsWeight: 2×7.5 kg
▶ Form guide
Keep the dumbbells close to your legs; stop the descent when your back position would change.
Chest press machine
2–3×8–12Weight: 15 kg shown on the machine
▶ Form guide
Set handles around mid-chest. Keep shoulder blades supported, press smoothly and stop just short of locking elbows hard.
Lat pulldown
2–3×8–12Weight: 20 kg shown on the machine
▶ Form guide
Grip just wider than shoulders, keep chest tall, pull bar toward upper chest and avoid swinging your body backward.
Standing calf raise
FORM
Stand tall, rise slowly onto the balls of your feet, pause at the top, then lower under control. Keep ankles straight rather than rolling outward.
2–3×10–15Weight: +10 kg
Side-lying hip abduction or band lateral walk
FORM
Lie on your side with the top leg straight. Lift it slightly back and up without rolling your hips open; lower slowly.
2×12–15/side
3Session Notes
Strength target this week: 3 sets • 8–10 reps • RPE 6–7
4HYROX Skill / Conditioning
Lunges: 3×12/leg bodyweight or light 5–8 kg
Weight: 5 kg
▶ Form guide
Use bodyweight if knee is amber; race load is a 10 kg sandbag.
5Session Notes
Rest 60–120 s between normal strength sets; longer if technique needs it
Training rule: form first. Use the prescribed load only while you can keep 2–3 clean reps in reserve.

Exercise Library

These are the same two-step movement visuals used inside your workout cards. Tap Form guide inside a workout for the key cues.

Leg Press

Feet about hip-width. Keep knees tracking over toes; lower only as far as you can control without your hips curling off the pad.

Romanian Deadlift

Soft knees, push hips backward, keep dumbbells close to legs, and stop when hamstrings are loaded without rounding your back.

Hip Thrust

Brace ribs down, drive through your feet and finish by squeezing glutes — not by arching your lower back.

Walking / Reverse Lunge

Take a comfortable step, keep front knee tracking over toes, and push through the whole front foot. Shorten range if your knee is irritated.

Step-Up

Place your whole foot on the box and drive through the working leg. Avoid pushing hard off the trailing foot.

Seated Cable Row

Sit tall, keep shoulders down, pull elbows back toward your ribs, then return slowly without rounding forward.

Lat Pulldown

Grip just wider than shoulders, keep chest tall, pull bar toward upper chest and avoid swinging your body backward.

Chest Press

Set handles around mid-chest. Keep shoulder blades supported, press smoothly and stop just short of locking elbows hard.

Farmer's Carry

Stand tall with ribs stacked over hips, shoulders relaxed, short controlled steps and no leaning side-to-side.

Wall Ball

Hold ball at chest, squat to a comfortable depth, stand powerfully and use that leg drive to send the ball to the target.

SkiErg

Start tall with arms high, hinge slightly and drive handles down using lats/core. Return smoothly rather than yanking with the arms.

Burpee Broad Jump

Step back at first if needed. Keep the movement controlled, land softly, then take a stable broad jump instead of chasing maximum distance.

Race Day

Women’s Doubles: both partners complete all 8 × 1 km runs. Station work is shared. Your plan progressively prepares you for SkiErg, sled demands through strength substitutes plus recommended real-sled practice later, burpee broad jumps, row, 2×16 kg farmer carry, 10 kg lunges and 4 kg wall balls.

Knee Care

Green: mild, stable discomfort and back to baseline by the next day → continue. Amber: pain clearly rises during the session or is worse next morning → swap running for easy bike/elliptical and reduce knee-dominant volume. Red: sharp pain, swelling, locking/giving-way, limping or persistent worsening → stop the provoking exercise and get assessed.

Nutrition

Keep the calorie target you and I already established rather than cutting harder as training rises. Aim for roughly 100–120 g protein/day, and use carbohydrate around longer or harder HYROX/run sessions to support training quality and recovery.
